text: SaaS has siloed our data for decades. This was a consequence of cloud software economics. But today apps are easier to build, and agents need all of our data to be useful. That demands a new data and security model.

Today we grant agents coarse-grained access to everything, with no audit and limited control. This approach is risky, and it simply doesn't work for agents that run continuously with evolving requirements.

The ECHO Database takes a fundamentally different approach. Enterprise, team and personal data live in a unified virtual semantic graph. Composer brings it all together in one super app, replacing dozens of separate SaaS tools.

The graph is partitioned into interconnected workspaces; enabling teams and agents to work within a secure shared context. Workspaces adapt to the work, drawing in data from different sources as each task requires.
And because it's open, it keeps growing. New sources, new apps and new agents plug into the same graph, and you never give up control. DXOS is the operating system for the new enterprise.
